newsitem.title: USA: Hallwood says 13.5 pct debt to pay interest.
newsitem.headline: Hallwood says 13.5 pct debt to pay interest.

text.p: Hallwood Group Inc said Monday its board has voted to pay in-kind annual interest on its 13.5 percent subordinated debentures due July 31, 2009.

The company said the payment will apply to all of the 1989 original notes, 1991 series, 1992 series and 1996 series. The company said interest will be paid on August 15 to debentureholders of record on July 31.
The company said certificates are issued in $100 multiples. Odd amounts are paid in cash.
Debentures trade net of accrued interest.
